formName: Step 7 - Co-applicant - Add a Business Applicant - Water Licence Application
formDescription: This popup collects legal identity, contact details, registration numbers, and mailing address information for a business co-applicant. Field keys and ids use data-id values from the source HTML when present; Cancel and Save have no data-id, so their element ids are used.

LegalName.title: Legal Name:
LegalName.description: The legal name of the business co-applicant.

DoingBusinessAs.title: Doing Business As:
DoingBusinessAs.description: The operating or trade name used by the business co-applicant, if different from the legal name.

PhoneNumber.title: Phone Number:
PhoneNumber.description: The primary phone number for the business co-applicant.

PhoneExtension.title: Ext:
PhoneExtension.description: Optional extension for the business co-applicant's primary phone number.

FaxNumber.title: Fax Number:
FaxNumber.description: Optional fax number for the business co-applicant.

Email.title: Email:
Email.description: Optional email address for the business co-applicant.

BCIncNo.title: BC Incorporation Number:
BCIncNo.description: The BC incorporation number for the business co-applicant, if applicable.

BusinessRegistrationNumber.title: Extra Provincial Inc. No:
BusinessRegistrationNumber.description: The extra-provincial incorporation number for the business co-applicant, if applicable.

SocietyNo.title: Society Number:
SocietyNo.description: The society number for the business co-applicant, if applicable.

GSTRegistrationNo.title: GST Registration No:
GSTRegistrationNo.description: The GST registration number for the business co-applicant, if applicable.

ContactName.title: Contact Name:
ContactName.description: The name of the contact person for the business co-applicant.

AddAddress_RT.title: Add Address
AddAddress_RT.description: Opens a popup to enter or look up the mailing address for the business co-applicant.

cphBottomFunctionBand_ctl06_Submit.title: Save
cphBottomFunctionBand_ctl06_Submit.description: Saves the business co-applicant details entered directly by the user.
